summary: Small, short-period summer regime all week with the clean windows living at dawn before the sea breeze fills in. Manasquan has the best quality this morning and Rockaway handles a dawn log fine at home — no reason to drive today. Thursday's offshore afternoon at Manasquan is the one trip worth considering, and Saturday brings NW offshores region-wide but the swell stays tiny; overall flat-ish and fading, weekend cleaner but small.
